0124a15421f4ea2e.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
0124a15421f4ea2e.crux: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs.

📊 **Key Results:** Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads.
🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** By jointly considering speedup and cost, STS enables the assessment of practical kernel optimization capability of a model or harness under an acceptable budget.

e6478749d856cb89.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
e6478749d856cb89.crux: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs.

📊 **Key Results:** Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves.
🚀 **Why It Matters:** Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.

a2ee7ec54152f003.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
a2ee7ec54152f003.crux: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction.

📊 **Key Results:** Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass.

🚀 **Why It Matters:** Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.

dc38ddba6ed267d4.title: PROLA: Principal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation for Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling
dc38ddba6ed267d4.crux: High-resolution weather prediction is important for resolving local atmospheric patterns missed by coarse global forecasts. Large pretrained weather backbones have improved global forecasting, but adapting them to produce future high-resolution fields from recent coarse states remains challenging and costly.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** To this end, we propose a framework that decomposes prediction into spatial and temporal stages using a shared pretrained backbone, fixed numerical scaffolds, and lightweight residual heads.

📊 **Key Results:** To this end, we propose a framework that decomposes prediction into spatial and temporal stages using a shared pretrained backbone, fixed numerical scaffolds, and lightweight residual heads.

80d3aa6dc1fe7960.title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
80d3aa6dc1fe7960.crux: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale.
📊 **Key Results:** Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes.
🚀 **Why It Matters:** More broadly, our work suggests a path for visual agents to scale their gameplay experience by building, verifying, and learning from existing game worlds.

6465a6769de7c824.title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
6465a6769de7c824.crux: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction.
📊 **Key Results:** We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion.

🚀 **Why It Matters:** ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.

9dff59f684a71d02.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
9dff59f684a71d02.crux: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains.

📊 **Key Results:** Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback.
🚀 **Why It Matters:** These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

f16d931b0ba194d8.title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
f16d931b0ba194d8.crux: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce WeMM-Video, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants.
key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** In this report, we introduce WeMM-Video, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants.

📊 **Key Results:** Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct responses and a thinking mode for explicit step-by-step reasoning.

🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** Evaluated across more than 120 benchmarks, WeMM-Video demonstrates superior performance in omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, while maintaining highly competitive capabilities across general audio, silent video, image, and text tasks.

7f4780b17bbef9b3.title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
7f4780b17bbef9b3.crux: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting.
📊 **Key Results:** Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics.

🚀 **Paradigm Shift:** Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines.

key_points: 💡 **Core Innovation:** Motivated by these findings, we propose Contraction for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (cmHC), an exact doubly stochastic method which geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope toward its interior.
